test_title: PYST 04: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 06 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What type of assistance is being provided by India to Myanmar under Operation Brahma 2025?

options.text: Disaster relief material, humanitarian assistance, search & rescue teams

solution:
The correct answer is __**Disaster relief material, humanitarian assistance, search & rescue teams**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Operation Brahma 2025** involves disaster relief efforts by India aimed at supporting Myanmar during emergencies or crises.
 
• India provides **humanitarian assistance**, including food supplies, medical aid, and essential relief materials.
 
• Search & rescue teams are dispatched to assist Myanmar in managing disaster situations effectively.
 
• The operation underscores India's commitment to regional cooperation and its proactive role in disaster management initiatives.
 
• Such efforts align with India's **"Neighborhood First" policy**, promoting solidarity and mutual support among neighboring nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Disaster Relief Terminology:**

 
 
• **Humanitarian Assistance:** Aid provided during emergencies to alleviate human suffering, including food, water, medical aid, and shelter.
 
• **Search & Rescue Teams:** Specialized units trained to locate and rescue individuals trapped or endangered during disasters.
 
• **Disaster Relief Material:** Essential supplies like blankets, water purifiers, tents, and food packets provided to affected populations.
 
 
 
• **India's Disaster Management Framework:**
 
 
• India follows a comprehensive disaster management plan under the **Disaster Management Act, 2005**.
 
• The **National Disaster Response Force (NDRF)** plays a pivotal role in managing emergencies and providing relief.
 
• India has demonstrated a strong commitment to international cooperation in disaster response, especially in South Asia.
 
 
 
• **"Neighborhood First" Policy:**
 
 
• India prioritizes building stronger ties with neighboring countries for mutual development and support.
 
• Disaster relief operations like Operation Brahma align with this policy to ensure regional stability and cooperation.
 
 
 
• **India's Role in Regional Disaster Management:**
 
 
• India frequently provides disaster relief to neighboring countries such as Nepal, Sri Lanka, and Bangladesh.
 
• These efforts showcase India's leadership in fostering solidarity and regional crisis management.
